Q: This recorded statement is regarding a motor vehicle incident in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the
record.
A: I'd rather just keep my name out of it for now, if that's alright. You can call me the claimant.
Q: That's acceptable for this recording. Can you describe what happened?
A: I was driving down the main road heading toward the shopping center. Traffic was light. Another car came into my
lane, and we ended up in a head-on collision. It was slow, though. I'd guess we were both going maybe fifteen or
twenty miles an hour when we met.
Q: Were you wearing a seatbelt at the time?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did the airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't. It was more of a hard jolt than anything.
Q: Where did you first feel pain or discomfort?
A: My right shoulder, mostly. I felt it pull as I grabbed the wheel. By that evening it was really sore, and I've had
trouble lifting my arm over my head since.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and was refererd to a physical therapist. I'm still going a couple of
times a week.
Q: Did you have any shoulder problems before this collision?
A: Not that I can recall. I had a bit of soreness after a workout once, but nothing that stopped me from working or
doing my daily activities.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Just that I'm cooperating fully and I want this resolved so I can get back to normal. Thank you.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
